''1ˢᵗ – 2ⁿᵈ'' - BelowNatural, LilDisquit & Beefchoplets |difficulty = Easy |length_measurement = 01:07.44 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Portland''' is a [[Maps|map]] which takes place in a city port. It has been remade once since its addition to the game. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Portland''' is a city port. The map itself is surrounded by hills on most sides, except the port, which is connected to water. There is a road on this map, which is blocked by rubble made by the broken bridge above the road, while the other is blocked by a police car. There are two tunnels which lead to the block, though the access to the road is blocked by roadblocks. In the blocked part of the road, five colorful buildings can be seen. Lamp posts can be seen on the pavement along the road. At the port there are multiple benches, recycle bins and dumpsters. On the concrete floor, multiple crayon drawings can be seen. This includes flowers, a house with a stickman and hopscotch boards. A few trees and hedges can also be found here. A stone statue with a top hat can be seen in the middle of the port. A red ship can be found docket at the port. A cargo ship and another port can also be seen in the sea. A mast can also be seen in the hills. The path starts and ends at two road tunnels. The path goes through the port due to the blockade on the road. After travelling through the port, the path goes back onto the road. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Portland''' was a city map that spans two islands. These islands were connected by a large suspension bridge. The first island contained the majority of the buildings, including a broken road bridge. A sewer could also be seen on the first island. The broken bridge did not symbolize anything. Two cargo ships could be seen around the map in the river. Two statues could also be found on the two islands. On the second island, not much could be found, except some containers and a radio mast. Several hills, orange cones and trees could be seen around the map. The black slate path started and ended at two caves. The path weaved around the broken bridge and buildings on the first island before going onto the bridge. On the second island, the path weaved around a singular tree only. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Portland''' was identical to the second version, except baseplate water surrounded the map, instead of terrain water. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:PortlandV3}} |Version 2 |{{Map:Portland}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *The bridge present on this map is a cliff spot, making cliff towers quite good on this map. *Ground towers should be placed in the port, as it allows your towers to cover a decent amount of the path. *The turns near the entrance can be useful for melee towers like the [[Warden]] and [[Brawler]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Portland.png|First & second version (13 October 2019 – 4 February 2023) {{GalleryHeader|View}} PView.png|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) PortlandView.png|Second version (29 October 2020 – 4 February 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Top Down}} RahneeportlandNOWATERMARK.png|Second version (29 October 2020 – 4 February 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.88.0GenericThumbnail.png|Current version on the game thumbnails. Skill Tree Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|Current version in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} PortlandDI1.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *'''Portland''' is based on the [[w:c:r2d:Portland|R2D]] and [[w:c:r2da:Portland|R2DA]] versions of the map with the same name. *The radio mast in '''Portland''' could have been seen in the lobby before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. *This [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Portland|map]] was originally made for ''Tower Battles'', it even appeared in the game's lobby for a while, but was later removed for unknown reasons, then it was remade and added to Tower Defense Simulator. ==Update History== *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Portland''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Color|Easy}} difficulty added. **Baseplate water replaced with terrain water. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Portland''' remade. **[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. {{MapNavBox}}
